ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Dense white mottling on the distal third with horizontal white streaks near the center. Right lobe: Predominantly dark central region with white clustering at the tip and a distinct circular white ring. Peduncle area: Low-intensity black with sparse white stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire boundary. Left lobe displays high-frequency, sharp-peaked saw-tooth variations. Right lobe displays slightly lower frequency, more rounded peaks toward the notch and sharp peaks near the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature transitioning into sharp upward-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of calcified, circular high-contrast pixels (barnacles) concentrated exclusively at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct horizontal white linear disruption on the mid-left lobe; multiple short, unaligned diagonal white rake marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular white ring lesion on the upper-right lobe surface; heavy barnacle encrustation at both fluke tips causing localized structural thickening.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'O'-shaped white pigmentation ring located on the medial-superior region of the right fluke lobe.
